title: Health Literacy for Children With Atopic Dermatitis and Their Caregivers
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the effectiveness of additional nursing instruction for the caregivers of newly diagnosed pediatric atopic dermatitis patients at the University of Missouri Dermatology clinic.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* New clinical diagnosis of pediatric atopic dermatitis, or existing atopic dermatitis but new patient to MU dermatology
* Age 7 or under

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age 8 or above
